name: Platform jump
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Allows proper platformer jumping.

How to use: assign the Jump command to a button on the hero model and the Fall command after each regular move option on the hero model (move north, east, etc). Assign the Maneuver function to the hero's default move options to allow horizontal control of the jump while airborne. These commands are meant for the hero but they can also be used for any map event.

WARNING! Due to how in-game collisions are coded, this plugin is still somewhat experimental. It may cause some bugs and make the characters clip through some objects, so build your maps carefully.

defaultParameters.name: Gravity
defaultParameters.description: Gravity acceleration in squares per second²

parameters.name: Gravity
parameters.description: Gravity acceleration in squares per second²

commands.name: Jump
commands.description: Jump to a certain height in a given time

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object to jump. -1 is self, 0 is hero

defaultParameters.name: peak
defaultParameters.description: The peak of the jump in game squares

commands.name: Fall
commands.description: Same as Jump, but starts at zero vertical velocity

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object to fall. -1 is self, 0 is hero

commands.name: Maneuver
commands.description: Manuver horizontal speed while airborne (or as an alternative movement option)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object. -1 is self, 0 is hero

defaultParameters.name: camera
defaultParameters.description: Whether to use camera orientation or not

commands.name: Check ground
commands.description: Checks whether map object of given ID is touching the ground

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object. -1 is self, 0 is hero

defaultParameters.name: prop
defaultParameters.description: The property ID to receive the result (swtch: ON/OFF) of the operation

commands.name: Set fixed velocity
commands.description: Set a fixed Y velocity for an object (disables gravity acceleration)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: The ID of the object. 0 is hero, -1 is self

defaultParameters.name: enable
defaultParameters.description: Turn fixed velocity ON/OFF (turning it OFF will re-enable default gravity)

defaultParameters.name: value
defaultParameters.description: The Y velocity in game squares per second
